lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of large, high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly parallel vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank, specifically posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a regular grid-like pattern on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, showing a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.
